summary: Structured Obligations Corp filed an 8-K reporting a routine distribution to holders of Select Notes Trust LT 2003-5 Certificates. The filing confirms an April 15, 2026 interest distribution, with interest received of $0.00 and no income reportable for 2026. It notes that the registrant and trustee did not prepare or verify underlying security issuers' reports. This is a standard trust administration update, not a corporate event. No special-situation activity is present.
